People around the world have been preparing for what they believe will be a major world disaster in the near future. Now, some tech billionaires are joining the trend by building underground bunker complexes to keep them safe if the world order collapses. Do they know something we don't? Neil discusses this with Hannah, from the What in the World podcast, and they teach you some new vocabulary.
This week's question
Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Meta, is building a property in Hawaii which is reported to include a huge underground bunker. How much is he reportedly spending on the project?
a) $10 million
b) $50 million
c) $100 million
Listen to the programme to hear the answer.
someone who believes disaster is likely to happen soon, and so prepares for it
the way someone thinks about things
an event which causes destruction and change
respect and importance
lower the standard of something
Note: This is not a word-for-word transcript.
